english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a contradiction, especially a logical inconsistency or conflict.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when the paradox involves an apparent contradiction or conflicting outcome.

examples.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 cin4 hau6 jau5 maau4 teon5

examples.english: Saying we want to save money but ending up spending more is a real paradox.
examples.traditional: 表面上話要慳錢，結果反而使多咗，真係矛盾。
examples.jyutping: biu2 min6 soeng6 waa6 jiu3 haan1 cin2 git3 gwo2 faan2 ji4 sai2 do1 zo2 zan1 hai6 maau4 teon5

english.note: Use 矛盾 when the tension is an actual conflict between people, sides, or opposing forces.

examples.english: The two of them argue all the time, and there is a lot of tension between them.
examples.traditional: 佢哋兩個成日鬧交，大家之間有好大矛盾。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 seng4 jat6 naau6 gaau1 daai6 gaa1 zi1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 daai6 maau4 teon5
